caption: The drawing shows an oval-shaped composition filled with intricate floral arrangements and two large cornucopias, which are placed symmetrically near the top left and right edges. The cornucopias are shaded in tones of gray, white, and black, and are filled with clusters of rounded fruits or flowers. Below and between the cornucopias, the main area of the oval is densely packed with various flowers, leaves, and stems, all rendered in grayscale. The flowers include several large blossoms, possibly roses, surrounded by a mix of smaller blooms and leafy foliage. The background within the oval is a flat medium gray, while the space outside the oval is left a plain, light beige or off-white color. Handwritten text is visible on the upper left and lower right corners of the page. The overall color palette consists only of black, white, and shades of gray, applied in watercolor and possibly ink.
title: Bandbox Cover
